parameters.content:
## 🔧 Weekly Analytics Report Setup

### Schedule
Runs every **Monday at 9:00 AM** (Europe/Rome timezone).

### Google Sheet Requirements
This workflow reads from 4 sheets:

**"Leads" sheet columns:**
- `signup_date` or `created_date` — ISO date
- `source` — lead source (organic, referral, etc.)
- `status` — Active, Converted, etc.

**"Content Drafts" sheet columns:**
- `created_date` or `date`
- `status` — Approved, Pending, Published

**"Feedback" sheet columns:**
- `timestamp` or `date`
- `rating` — numeric 1-5
- `would_recommend` — boolean

**"Waitlist" sheet columns:**
- `signup_date` or `date`

**"Analytics" sheet columns (auto-populated):**
- `report_date`, `week_start`, `total_leads`, `new_leads`
- `conversion_rate`, `content_published`, `avg_feedback_rating`
- `waitlist_size`, `total_referrals`, `wow_growth`

### Adding Recipients
Edit the **Telegram - Send Report** node to add CC/BCC recipients.
Or change `to` list to a distribution list email.

### Customizing Metrics
Edit the **Calculate Analytics** Code node to:
- Add/remove metrics
- Change time window (default: 7 days)
- Adjust conversion definitions

### Replace Placeholders
- `YOUR_TEAM_EMAIL@example.com` — team distribution email
- `YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` — Telegram group chat ID
- `Eki` — your app name
- `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_URL` — your Google Sheet URL
